## Type of change

- [ ] Lesson or docs content (`website/content/`)

- [ ] Docs site code (`website/src/`)

## How it was tested

- [ ] Commands in the lesson were run against LocalStack and the output matches
- [ ] `make site-lint` and `make site-build` pass (if `website/` changed)
- [ ] English and Bangla versions are both updated (or the gap is noted below)
- [ ] README / learning plan updated where behavior or scope changed
- [ ] For UI changes: screenshots attached (light and dark, mobile and desktop)
